title: Affine higher direct image cohomology vanishing
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], with $S$ affine. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ which is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], every $q\in\mathbb N$ and every $p>0$, the module $H^p(S,R^q f_*M)$ is zero. Ordinary higher direct images and module cohomology are [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology].

proof.text: Install the quasi-coherence instance of M and the enough-injectives instance supplied by moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives. Apply Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage to the ordinary right derived moduleDirectImage object in degree q. Only clause (1) of the qcqs higher-image theorem is used; no uniform bound is needed.

Apply affine vanishing to each R^q f_*M. The source comparison identifies its Ext-model cohomology with module right-derived global sections. Transfer the subsingleton additive group across this equivalence; a module with subsingleton underlying additive group is a zero object. This includes q=0, the zero module and the empty affine base.

theorem isZero_affine_higherDirectImage_moduleCohomology
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [IsAffine S]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (q p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology S.toRingedSpace p).obj
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived q).obj M))
